source_observation: The durable erasure job has no CACHE step. Exact discovered subject keys profile:<id>, profile:user:<id>, profile:anon:<id> and paginated override:<id>:* remain tenant-scoped and readable after local completion. Pending version-1 jobs persist a numeric cursor over dynamically derived legacy steps, so inserting new steps into that sequence would silently reinterpret progress.
reproduction_basis: Source-confirmed by two independent Astra/xhigh reads of actual writers/readers and job state. Existing identity fixture will seed and inspect actual CACHE keys/read behavior; no extra baseline suite or new harness.
limits: Known discovered subject CACHE keys only; no email aliases, in-memory caches, orphan discovery, concurrency/deletion generation, ring/seen, D1, AE/logs/external, retention, deployed/customer or release acceptance.
